messages:
Noah: flying to Chicago for the offsite next month. quick logistics check: share-ride from O'Hare or Lakeview hotel? also whos bringing a steamer for wrinkled shirts? :shirt: 
Priya: O'Hare -> Lakeview is around 30-45min traffic. If you're landing at ORD after 6pm expect longer. I usually prebook a Lyft to lock a price.
Aiden: shuttle + train combo can be cheaper but more walking. If you have a lot of luggage, ride-share or taxi is nicer.
Grace: steamer? I can bring a handheld one if we want to share. else wrinkle-release spray works in a pinch.
Noah: @Grace legend. if you bring it can you label it 'redwood'? people keep borrowing mine :sweat_smile: 
tripbot: FYI: Offsite travel checklist reminder sent to attendees. Agenda + hotel details: https://intranet.example/offsite-chicago
Priya: poll: who wants group check-in to coordinate shuttles Friday morning? react with :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Aiden: +1 for group check-in. easier to coordinate brunch plans.
Grace: thumbs up. also can anyone lend an international adapter? I have a UK one only.
Noah: I have a universal adapter, will bring it. also bringing extra USB-C cables.
Priya: packing tip: bring a small lint roller and a backup collared shirt. Chicago wind = hair chaos.
Noah: perfect, thanks. see y'all in Chi-town 3fb
